# Shibumi 0.2.5

2026-11-18

Performance release for Omarchy 4.5: validated on Omarchy 4.5.0 (package 4.5.0-3, source v4.5.0 at ac2690cd7); forward reference 551dc629. 0.2.0 to 0.2.4 installations update in place.

## What's Changed

### Performance

- **perf:** run the AI usage collection at the lowest CPU priority and on the last quarter of the CPU cores, so a refresh no longer saturates the whole machine (18e16d9f)
- **perf:** open the AI usage panel without starting a provider discovery; newly installed providers appear with the next discovery, at most six hours later, or via Refresh (b6f6f75f)
- **perf:** refresh only the limits of the visible provider tabs when the AI usage panel opens (5fbbcc6a)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/HANCORE-linux/Shibumi-Shell/compare/v0.2.4...v0.2.5
